import arrow

def test_maltese():
    # Test Maltese locale 'mt'
    # Using a fixed time for consistency
    t = arrow.get(2023, 10, 23) # A Monday
    
    # Test day name
    assert t.format('dddd', locale='mt') == 'tnejn'
    
    # Test month name
    assert t.format('MMMM', locale='mt') == 'Ottubru'
    
    # Test month abbreviation
    assert t.format('MMM', locale='mt') == 'Ott'
    
    # Test day abbreviation
    assert t.format('ddd', locale='mt') == 'tnejn'

    # Test humanize (past/future)
    t_past = arrow.get(2023, 10, 20) # 3 days before 23rd
    delta = arrow.Arrow(2023, 10, 23).humanize(t_past, locale='mt')
    # 3 days ago -> 3 ġurnati ilu
    assert delta == '3 ġurnati ilu'

    t_future = arrow.get(2023, 10, 26) # 3 days after 23rd
    delta = arrow.Arrow(2023, 10, 23).humanize(t_future, locale='mt')
    # in 3 days -> sadir 3 ġurnati
    assert delta == 'sadir 3 ġurnati'

def test_malay_whitespace():
    t = arrow.get(2023, 10, 22) # A Sunday
    # Test day name for Malay
    assert t.format('dddd', locale='ms') == 'Ahad'
    assert t.format('ddd', locale='ms') == 'Ahad'

if __name__ == "__main__":

        print("Maltese tests passed!")
        test_malay_whitespace()
        print("Malay whitespace tests passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
